identity.title: [v0.92.1][AWS-D-R] Apply and prove the audit/security account foundation

values.task_boundary: One AWS-D account-foundation reconciliation and redacted proof packet.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1 exact account region source backend workspace and saved-plan preflight
AC-5 evidence contains digests and booleans without sensitive values
AC-6 partial failure reconciles or reports residue
AC-7 fresh exact-head review before publication
non_goals: website Runtime DDNS public edge GCP or application security
